name: Classic Margherita Pizza
directions: Preheat oven to 250°C (482°F) with a baking stone if available.
Roll out dough to a 12-inch circle on a floured surface.
Spread tomato sauce evenly over dough, leaving a 1/2-inch border.
Scatter mozzarella cheese over sauce.
Bake on the stone for 10-12 minutes until crust is crisp and cheese melts.
Finish with basil leaves, drizzle with olive oil, and season with salt and optional parmesan.
Slice and serve immediately.
image_description: The image shows a Classic Margherita Pizza, cut into four slices with one slice partially pulled away from the rest. The pizza has a charred crust and is topped with red sauce, melted white cheese, and fresh green basil leaves. It is presented on a round wooden serving board with a handle.

name: Chicken Tikka Masala
ingredients: 1 cup heavy cream or coconut cream
directions: Marinate chicken in yogurt, lemon juice, garam masala, cumin, coriander, and a pinch of salt for at least 30 minutes.
In a large pan, heat oil and sauté onion until translucent.
Add garlic and ginger; cook 1 minute until fragrant.
Add marinated chicken; cook until browned on all sides.
Stir in crushed tomatoes and simmer 15 minutes.
Reduce heat and add cream; simmer 5-10 minutes until sauce thickens.
Garnish with cilantro and serve with rice or naan.
image_description: The image shows a dish of Chicken Tikka Masala, a popular Indian-inspired recipe, served in a copper-colored metal bowl with handles on either side. The dish contains chunks of grilled chicken in a rich, reddish-orange sauce, garnished with fresh green herbs, and is accompanied by a side of white rice and naan bread. The portion is generous, with several pieces of chicken visible in the sauce.

name: Vegetable Stir-Fry with Tofu
directions: Toss tofu with soy sauce and cornstarch.
Heat oil in a wok or large skillet over high heat.
Fry tofu until golden; remove and set aside.
Add garlic and vegetables; stir-fry 3-4 minutes until crisp-tender.
Return tofu to pan; add rice vinegar, hoisin sauce, and sesame oil.
Cook 1-2 minutes until coated; serve with steamed rice.
image_description: The image shows a bowl of Vegetable Stir-Fry with Tofu, featuring a medley of broccoli, carrots, snap peas, and cubed tofu in a savory brown sauce. The dish is served in a white bowl alongside a smaller bowl of white rice and a pair of chopsticks. The portion is generous, filling the bowl with a colorful and appetizing mix of vegetables and tofu.

name: Greek Giouvertsa Salad with Lemon-Oregano Dressing
directions: Toss romaine, cucumber, tomatoes, onion, olives, and feta in a bowl.
Whisk olive oil, lemon juice, oregano, salt, and pepper to make dressing.
Pour dressing over the salad and toss to combine.
Serve immediately.
image_description: The image depicts a Greek salad, also known as a "Giouvertsa Salad," in a large white bowl, featuring a mix of lettuce, halved cherry tomatoes, sliced cucumbers, Kalamata olives, thinly sliced red onions, and crumbled feta cheese. A silver serving spoon is partially submerged in the salad. The bowl is accompanied by a small glass bowl of dressing and a lemon wedge on the side.

name: Spaghetti Aglio e Olio
directions: Cook spaghetti in salted water until al dente; reserve 1/2 cup pasta water.
Heat olive oil in a pan; add garlic and red pepper flakes, cook until fragrant and lightly golden.
Toss pasta with garlic oil, adding reserve water as needed.
Season, mix in parsley, and serve with parmesan.
image_description: The image shows a bowl of Spaghetti Aglio e Olio, with a generous serving of cooked spaghetti tossed in a light yellow sauce, topped with grated Parmesan cheese, chopped parsley, and visible garlic slices. The dish is presented in a white bowl on a wooden table, accompanied by a fork and other ingredients. The portion appears to be a single serving.

name: Distance-Glazed Salmon with Dill
directions: Preheat oven to 200°C (400°F).
Mix honey, soy sauce, mustard, and dill.
Season salmon with salt and pepper; brush with glaze.
Bake 10-12 minutes until flaky; drizzle remaining glaze over and serve.
image_description: The image shows a glazed salmon fillet, cut into four portions, on a wooden serving board with a silver serving utensil. The salmon is topped with a brown glaze, dill, and spices, and is accompanied by lemon wedges and a small bowl of glaze. The dish is garnished with fresh dill sprigs and spices scattered around the board.

name: Tomato Basil Soup
directions: Sauté onion and garlic in olive oil until translucent.
Add crushed tomatoes and broth; simmer 15 minutes.
Blend until smooth or leave chunky based on preference.
Stir in cream and basil; season to taste and serve.
image_description: The image shows a bowl of Tomato Basil Soup, garnished with fresh basil leaves and herbs, and surrounded by various ingredients such as tomatoes, garlic, and chili peppers. The soup is a vibrant red color and is served in a light blue bowl with a brown rim. The portion appears to be a single serving, and the soup is presented in a visually appealing way, with the garnishes and surrounding ingredients adding to its appetizing appearance.

name: Pad Thai
ingredients: 1 tablespoon palm sugar or brown sugar
directions: Prepare noodles according to package; drain and set aside.
Mix tamarind paste, fish sauce, and sugar to make sauce.
Sauté garlic in oil; add shrimp or chicken and cook through.
Push meat aside, scramble eggs in the pan, then mix with noodles.
Add sauce and bean sprouts; toss quickly.
Garnish with peanuts, lime wedges, and chili flakes if desired.
image_description: The image depicts a large, shallow ceramic plate filled with Pad Thai, a stir-fry dish made with rice noodles, shrimp, scrambled eggs, bean sprouts, green onions, and cashews. The dish is garnished with four whole cooked shrimp on top and a lime wedge on the side, and is presented on a wooden table surrounded by various ingredients and seasonings. The portion is generous, with a substantial amount of noodles and toppings visible in the plate.

name: Chickpea Falafel with Tahini
ingredients: Tahini sauce: 1/4 cup tahini, lemon juice, water
directions: Pulse chickpeas, onion, garlic, parsley, flour, and spices until coarse.
Form into small patties or balls.
Fry in hot oil until golden and crisp.
Whisk tahini with lemon juice and water to desired consistency.
Serve falafel with tahini sauce.
image_description: The image shows a plate of seven golden-brown chickpea falafel, garnished with parsley and served with sliced red onions, green onions, garlic, and a lemon wedge. The falafel is arranged on a blue-green plate, surrounded by various ingredients and condiments, including a bowl of tahini sauce. The dish is presented as part of a recipe, with ingredients and instructions listed around the plate.

name: Beef Tacos with Salsa Verde
directions: Cook beef with taco seasoning until browned.
Warm tortillas in a dry skillet.
Fill tortillas with beef, lettuce, tomatoes, and cheese.
Top with salsa verde and sour cream if desired.
image_description: The image shows a plate of four tacos filled with seasoned ground beef, shredded cheese, lettuce, diced tomatoes, salsa verde, and sour cream. The tacos are arranged on a dark gray plate, surrounded by various toppings and condiments in small bowls, including salsa, shredded cheese, and sour cream. The presentation is vibrant and appetizing, with a lime wedge and scattered diced peppers adding to the overall visual appeal.

name: Pan-Seared Ribeye Steak
directions: Season steaks with salt and pepper.
Sear in a hot pan with butter until desired doneness (about 4-5 minutes per side for medium-rare).
Add garlic and thyme during the last minute, spooning butter over steaks.
Rest 5 minutes before serving.
image_description: The image showcases a pan-seared ribeye steak, cooked to a medium-rare and sliced into thick strips, resting in a dark brown skillet. The steak is garnished with sprigs of thyme and accompanied by three cubes of butter. The skillet is surrounded by various seasonings, including salt, peppercorns, and garlic cloves, which are arranged on a dark gray surface.

name: Lentil Dal with Cumin and Turmeric
directions: Rinse lentils until water runs clear.
Sauté onion and garlic in oil until soft.
Add cumin and turmeric, cook 1 minute.
Add lentils and water; simmer 20-25 minutes until soft.
Season and garnish with cilantro.
image_description: The image shows a bowl of Lentil Dal with Cumin and Turmeric, garnished with a slice of lime, sliced tomatoes, onions, and fresh cilantro. The dal is served in a beige ceramic bowl and has a thick, reddish-brown consistency with visible lentils and spices. The bowl is placed on a beige cloth napkin, surrounded by various ingredients, including a small bowl of turmeric powder, garlic cloves, an onion, and additional cilantro.

name: Miso-Glazed Cod with Sesame Rice
ingredients: Sesame seeds and green onions for garnish
directions: Whisk miso, mirin, soy sauce, and sugar to make glaze.
Brush cod with glaze and let sit 5 minutes.
Pan-sear or bake cod until flaky.
Fluff rice with sesame oil, top with cod, sesame seeds, and green onions.
image_description: The image depicts a dish of Miso-Glazed Cod with Sesame Rice, presented on a large ceramic plate with a brown and green glaze. The cod is glazed with a brown sauce and topped with sesame seeds and chopped green onions, served on a bed of white rice that is also garnished with sesame seeds and green onions. A small bowl of white rice, a bowl of sesame seeds, and a bowl of dark brown sauce are arranged around the main plate.

name: Caribbean Jerk Chicken
directions: Marinate chicken with jerk seasoning, lime juice, olive oil, and salt for 20 minutes.
Grill or bake until cooked through, about 20-25 minutes.
Rest briefly and serve with sides like rice and beans.
image_description: The image showcases a Caribbean Jerk Chicken dish, featuring four seasoned chicken pieces on a wooden platter. The chicken is garnished with rosemary sprigs and accompanied by lime wedges, with additional ingredients such as rice, salt, and beans visible in surrounding bowls. The presentation is rustic and appetizing, with a generous portion of chicken and accompaniments.

name: Roasted Tomato and Basil Pasta
directions: Roast tomatoes and garlic with olive oil for 15-20 minutes.
Cook pasta until al dente, reserve 1/2 cup pasta water.
Toss pasta with roasted tomatoes, add water to loosen if needed.
Stir in torn basil and parmesan; season to taste.
image_description: The image shows a plate of penne pasta mixed with roasted cherry tomatoes and fresh basil leaves, topped with grated Parmesan cheese and black pepper. The dish is presented on a rustic, earth-toned plate, surrounded by additional ingredients and garnishes. The portion appears to be a single serving.

name: Paneer Butter Masala
directions: Fry paneer lightly until golden; set aside.
Sauté onion with butter, add ginger-garlic paste.
Add tomato puree and simmer 10 minutes.
Stir in cream, garam masala, and paneer; simmer 5 minutes.
Season to taste and serve with rice or naan.
image_description: The image shows a bowl of Paneer Butter Masala, a popular Indian dish. The curry is a vibrant orange-red color and contains large cubes of paneer, sliced onions, and garnished with fresh herbs. The dish is served in a large, shallow bowl and is accompanied by naan bread and steamed rice.

name: Falooda (Dessert Drink)
ingredients: Cherries or shredded coconut for garnish
directions: In tall glasses, layer milk, rose syrup, soaked vermicelli, and sabja.
Add ice and garnish with cherries or coconut.
Serve with a spoon and straw.
image_description: The image shows two glasses of Falooda, a popular Indian dessert drink, filled with layers of red jelly, vermicelli noodles, and white milk. The glasses are garnished with whipped cream, cherries, and rose petals, and are placed on a gray stone slab surrounded by various toppings and ingredients. The portion is for two servings, with each glass containing a generous amount of the dessert drink.

name: Shakshuka
directions: Sauté onion and pepper in olive oil until soft.
Add garlic, tomatoes, paprika, and cumin; simmer 10 minutes.
Make four wells in sauce and crack in eggs.
Cover and cook until eggs set; garnish with parsley.
image_description: The image depicts a vibrant Shakshuka dish, presented in a black skillet and garnished with fresh herbs. The skillet contains six eggs poached in a rich, red sauce made with sliced red and green peppers, onions, and tomatoes. The dish is surrounded by an assortment of ingredients, including spices, herbs, garlic, and chili peppers, arranged in small bowls and scattered around the skillet.

name: Cuban Black Beans and Rice
ingredients: 1 cup dried black beans (or 2 cans, drained)
directions: Soak beans if using dried (overnight recommended).
Sauté onion and garlic in oil; add beans, bay leaf, cumin, and water.
Simmer until beans are tender (about 45 minutes for dried).
Serve over rice.
image_description: The image depicts a plate of Cuban Black Beans and Rice, featuring a generous serving of white rice surrounded by dark brown beans. The dish is garnished with sliced garlic and two green leaves on top of the rice, and is presented on a white plate with a black rim. The portion appears to be a single serving.

name: Beef Bulgogi
ingredients: 500g sirloin or flank steak, thinly sliced
directions: Marinate beef with soy sauce, sugar, sesame oil, garlic, and ginger for 15-20 minutes.
Stir-fry in a hot pan 2-3 minutes until cooked.
Garnish with green onion and sesame seeds; serve with rice.
image_description: The image depicts a dish of Beef Bulgogi, a Korean marinated beef dish. The beef is sliced into thin strips and cooked to a medium-rare, with a dark brown color on the outside and a pinkish-red color on the inside, and is garnished with green onions and sesame seeds. The beef is served on a large gray plate, surrounded by various ingredients and seasonings, including bowls of white rice, sesame seeds, and spices.

name: Spanish Paella Valenciana
directions: Brown chicken and chorizo in olive oil; set aside.
Sauté onion and pepper; add tomatoes and cook until soft.
Add rice, saffron, and broth; bring to boil.
Return meat, cover, simmer until rice is cooked and liquid absorbed.
Rest 5 minutes before serving.
image_description: The image depicts a large pan of Spanish Paella Valenciana, filled with yellow rice, chicken, tomatoes, onions, and rosemary. The dish is garnished with red peppers and presented in a black pan with two handles, surrounded by various ingredients such as onions, garlic, tomatoes, and spices on a dark wooden table. The portion appears to be sufficient for multiple servings.

name: Tom Yum Goong
directions: Boil stock with lemongrass, lime leaves, and galangal for 10 minutes.
Add mushrooms and shrimp; cook until shrimp turn pink.
Season with fish sauce and lime juice; add chili paste if desired.
image_description: The image shows a bowl of Tom Yum Goong, a Thai soup, served in a white ceramic bowl. The soup contains large shrimp, mushrooms, lemongrass, lime leaves, red chili peppers, and cilantro, all floating in a light brown broth. A white spoon is partially submerged in the soup, and a slice of lime is visible on the right side of the bowl.

name: Chicken Caesar Salad
directions: Grill or pan-sear chicken; slice.
Toss lettuce with dressing and croutons.
Top with chicken slices and parmesan.
image_description: The image presents a Chicken Caesar Salad in a dark gray bowl, featuring romaine lettuce, cherry tomatoes, croutons, and shaved parmesan cheese, all tossed in a creamy dressing. Sliced grilled chicken breast is placed on top of the salad, adding protein to the dish. The salad is generously portioned, filling the bowl.

name: Moussaka
ingredients: Bechamel sauce: butter, flour, milk, nutmeg
directions: Roast eggplant slices until tender.
Cook lamb with onion and garlic; add tomatoes and season.
Layer eggplant and meat mixture in dish; top with bechamel.
Bake until golden and set.
image_description: The image depicts a Moussaka dish, a traditional Greek layered casserole, presented in a rectangular baking pan. The visible ingredients include sliced eggplant, a meat-based filling, and a white bechamel sauce, topped with a sprinkle of fresh herbs. The dish is arranged in a neat and visually appealing manner, with a generous portion size.

name: Shoyu Ramen (Quick)
directions: Simmer broth with soy sauce and miso.
Cook noodles separately.
Assemble bowls with broth, noodles, meat, egg, and green onions.
image_description: The image depicts a steaming bowl of Shoyu Ramen, a Japanese noodle soup, presented in a dark brown ceramic bowl. The dish features a rich, brown broth with visible noodles, sliced chicken, green onions, black sesame seeds, and two halves of a soft-boiled egg. The ingredients are artfully arranged, creating a visually appealing composition.

name: Lemon Garlic Shrimp Pasta
directions: Cook pasta until al dente.
Sauté garlic in olive oil; add shrimp until pink.
Toss with pasta, lemon zest/juice, and parsley.
Season and serve.
image_description: The image depicts a plate of lemon garlic shrimp pasta, featuring cooked shrimp, green beans, and lemon slices on top of a bed of fettuccine noodles. The dish is presented in a large, shallow ceramic bowl with a speckled brown glaze and is garnished with herbs and black pepper. The portion appears to be generous, with a substantial amount of pasta and shrimp visible.

name: Ratatouille
directions: Sauté onion and garlic in olive oil.
Add vegetables; cook slowly with herbs until tender.
Season and serve warm or room temp.
image_description: The image depicts a vibrant bowl of ratatouille, filled with an assortment of sliced vegetables including zucchini, eggplant, tomatoes, and red peppers. The dish is presented in a white bowl, surrounded by additional ingredients such as whole vegetables, herbs, and spices on a wooden cutting board. The overall presentation is colorful and appetizing, with a generous portion of ratatouille displayed prominently in the center of the image.

name: Crispy Skin Salmon with Dill Yogurt
directions: Season salmon; sear skin-side down in butter until crisp.
Flip and cook to desired doneness.
Mix yogurt with dill and a squeeze of lemon; serve with salmon.
image_description: The image shows a plate of Crispy Skin Salmon with Dill Yogurt. The plate contains two pieces of salmon, seasoned with black pepper and garnished with dill, accompanied by a side of white yogurt sauce infused with dill and a sprinkle of seasoning, as well as lemon wedges. The dish is presented on a ceramic plate with a brown rim, placed on a folded napkin and set against a dark wooden table.

name: Thai Green Curry with Vegetables
ingredients: Assorted vegetables (bell peppers, zucchini, snow peas)
directions: Sauté curry paste briefly in oil.
Add coconut milk and simmer 5 minutes.
Add protein and vegetables; cook until tender.
Season with fish sauce and garnish with herbs; serve over rice.
image_description: The image shows a bowl of Thai Green Curry with Vegetables, served with a generous portion of white rice. The curry is filled with an assortment of colorful vegetables, including sliced bell peppers, zucchini, snow peas, and tofu, all mixed in a vibrant green sauce and garnished with basil leaves. The dish is presented in a large, shallow bowl with a pair of chopsticks resting on the side.

name: Mango Sticky Rice
directions: Cook rice in water until tender.
Warm coconut milk with sugar and salt.
Pour coconut sauce over cooked rice and let absorb.
Serve with mango slices.
image_description: The image depicts a vibrant and appetizing dish of Mango Sticky Rice, presented on a blue plate alongside a bowl of the same dessert. The sticky rice is served with diced mango and a rich, orange sauce, garnished with green leaves, and is accompanied by various ingredients and a recipe card detailing its preparation. The portion appears to be a single serving, carefully arranged to showcase the dish's colorful and inviting appearance.

name: Herbed Quinoa Salad
ingredients: Lemon vinaigrette: lemon juice, olive oil, salt, pepper
directions: Cook quinoa in water until fluffy; cool.
Toss with vegetables, herbs, and vinaigrette.
Chill 10 minutes before serving if desired.
image_description: The image depicts a bowl of Herbed Quinoa Salad, comprising cooked quinoa, halved cherry tomatoes, sliced cucumbers, and parsley leaves. The salad is presented in a white ceramic bowl with a brown rim, placed on a gray surface and garnished with additional parsley leaves and lemon wedges. The portion is a generous serving, likely intended for one person.

name: Beef Shawarma Wrap
directions: Marinate beef with shawarma spices.
Cook beef in a hot pan until done.
Fill pitas with beef and vegetables; drizzle with sauce.
image_description: The image showcases a Beef Shawarma Wrap, featuring a generous serving of sliced beef, crisp lettuce, juicy tomatoes, crunchy cucumbers, and thinly sliced onions, all wrapped in a toasted pita bread. The wrap is neatly tied with twine and presented on a dark surface, surrounded by various accompaniments. The accompanying dishes include bowls of creamy sauces and dips, sliced cucumbers, and spices, adding to the overall appeal of the dish.

name: Pesto Chicken Bake
directions: Season chicken and place in baking dish.
Top each with pesto, mozzarella, and tomatoes.
Bake at 200°C (400°F) for 22-25 minutes until chicken is cooked.
image_description: The image depicts a baked dish of Pesto Chicken, featuring four cooked chicken breasts on a bed of noodles, topped with melted cheese, pesto sauce, and cherry tomatoes. The dish is presented in a white baking pan with handles on either side, accompanied by a spoonful of pesto sauce and utensils on a napkin to the side. The portion appears to be sufficient for four servings.

name: Baked Eggplant Parmesan
directions: Dip eggplant slices in egg then breadcrumbs; bake until tender.
Layer with marinara and cheese; bake until golden.
image_description: The image shows a baked eggplant parmesan in a rectangular baking dish, layered with breaded eggplant slices, tomato sauce, and melted cheese topped with shredded cheese. The dish is surrounded by various ingredients, including bowls of tomato sauce and grated cheese, as well as fresh tomatoes and onions. The portion appears to be a large serving, likely for multiple people.

name: Moroccan Chickpea Stew
directions: Sauté onion and garlic; add spices.
Add chickpeas and tomatoes; simmer 15-20 minutes.
Garnish with cilantro and serve.
image_description: The Moroccan Chickpea Stew is presented in a decorative brown ceramic bowl with a generous serving of chickpeas and diced tomatoes in a rich red broth, garnished with fresh cilantro leaves. The bowl is placed on a wooden surface, accompanied by a spoon to the left and surrounded by various ingredients and spices. The stew appears to be a hearty and flavorful dish, with visible chickpeas and tomatoes.

name: Crunchy Cabbage Slaw
directions: Mix dressing ingredients.
Toss with shredded cabbage and carrot.
Chill slightly before serving.
image_description: The image shows a large blue bowl filled with a crunchy cabbage slaw made from shredded green cabbage and carrots. The slaw is presented on a brown table, surrounded by smaller bowls containing the individual ingredients, including shredded carrots, mayonnaise, and various seasonings. The portion is generous, with a substantial amount of slaw visible in the central bowl.

name: Ceviche de Pescado
directions: Cure fish in lime juice for about 10-15 minutes until opaque.
Mix with onion, chili, and cilantro; season and serve.
image_description: The image shows a bowl of Ceviche de Pescado, a dish consisting of raw white fish marinated in citrus juices. The bowl is filled with diced fish, thinly sliced red onions, halved red chili peppers, and cilantro leaves, garnished with a lime wedge on top. The dish is presented in a brown ceramic bowl on a wooden cutting board, surrounded by additional ingredients such as whole red chili peppers, a whole lime, sliced red onion, and lime halves.

name: Thai Basil Chicken (Pad Krapow Gai)
directions: Sauté garlic and chili in oil until fragrant.
Add chicken and cook through.
Stir in soy and fish sauces; toss with basil until wilted.
Serve over steamed rice.
image_description: The image shows a plate of Thai Basil Chicken (Pad Krapow Gai) served with a generous portion of white rice. The dish is presented on a large, shallow plate with a decorative blue pattern around the rim, filled with stir-fried chicken, Thai basil leaves, and sliced red chilies in a savory sauce. The meal is garnished with additional Thai basil leaves on top and accompanied by a small bowl of dark sauce with red chili flakes on the side.

name: Caprese Salad
directions: Alternate tomato and mozzarella slices on a plate.
Top with basil; drizzle olive oil and balsamic glaze.
Season with salt and pepper.
image_description: The image shows a Caprese Salad on a white plate, featuring sliced tomatoes and mozzarella cheese arranged in an alternating pattern, garnished with fresh basil leaves. The salad is dressed with olive oil and balsamic glaze, and is presented on a wooden board with a fork and a small bowl of balsamic glaze. The portion appears to be a generous serving, likely for one or two people.

name: Pumpkin Risotto
directions: Sauté onion in olive oil until translucent.
Add rice and toast 1-2 minutes.
Add warm broth gradually, stirring until absorbed.
Stir in pumpkin puree, butter, and parmesan; season to taste.
image_description: The image depicts a pan of pumpkin risotto, with the dish divided into four quadrants, each showcasing a different stage of preparation. The risotto is creamy and pale yellow, topped with diced pumpkin, thinly sliced red onions, and a pat of butter melting into the rice, with a spoon resting in the pan. The pan is surrounded by various ingredients, including a whole pumpkin, shallots, salt, and broth.

name: Garlic Butter Shrimp
directions: Melt butter; add garlic and cook 1 minute.
Add shrimp; cook until pink.
Squeeze lemon juice; garnish with parsley and serve.
image_description: The image depicts a skillet filled with garlic butter shrimp, featuring large pink shrimp cooked in a yellowish sauce with visible garlic cloves and parsley. The skillet is presented on a wooden tray, accompanied by two forks, lemon wedges, and whole garlic bulbs, suggesting a serving size for one or two people. The dish is garnished with parsley and served with condiments in small bowls.

name: Roasted Red Pepper Hummus
directions: Blend all ingredients until smooth.
Drizzle with olive oil and serve with pita or veggies.
image_description: The image depicts a bowl of Roasted Red Pepper Hummus, garnished with a spiral pattern of olive oil, red chili peppers, and chickpeas. The hummus is presented in a dark brown ceramic bowl, surrounded by various ingredients such as pita bread, garlic cloves, and additional red peppers. The dish is served on a dark wooden table, accompanied by a small wooden spoon containing coarse salt.

name: Garlic Naan
directions: Mix ingredients to form dough; knead until smooth.
Let rise 1 hour; divide and roll into rounds.
Cook on hot skillet 2-3 minutes per side.
Brush with garlic butter and serve.
image_description: The image shows a plate of garlic naan bread, with five pieces arranged in a circular pattern on a brown plate. The naan is lightly browned and topped with garlic cloves and herbs, accompanied by a small bowl of garlic cloves in the center. The plate is set with a fork to the left and a knife to the right.

name: Butter Chicken
directions: Sauté onion and garlic in butter.
Add chicken and cook until sealed.
Stir in tomato sauce and garam masala; simmer 15 minutes.
Stir in cream; season and serve with rice or naan.
image_description: The image depicts a vibrant dish of Butter Chicken, presented in a blue bowl. The chicken is cooked in a rich, reddish-orange sauce and is accompanied by onions, peas, and herbs, creating a visually appealing composition. The generous serving is garnished with fresh herbs and spices, adding to the dish's appetizing appearance.

name: Coconut Curry Lentil Soup
directions: Sauté onion and garlic; add curry powder.
Add lentils, coconut milk, and broth; simmer 25 minutes.
Season and serve hot.
image_description: The image depicts a steaming bowl of Coconut Curry Lentil Soup, garnished with dried red chilies, onions, and herbs. The soup is served in a brown ceramic bowl and has a vibrant orange-yellow color, with a creamy texture and visible lentils. The bowl is surrounded by various ingredients, including turmeric powder, lentils, lemons, and onions, which are arranged on a dark surface.

name: Gyro Wrap
ingredients: Gyro meat (lamb or chicken) or substitute with sliced chicken
directions: Cook gyro meat until browned.
Warm pita; fill with meat and vegetables.
Top with tzatziki.
image_description: The image depicts a Gyro Wrap, a traditional Greek dish, consisting of a toasted pita bread filled with sliced meat, tomatoes, cucumbers, red onions, and tzatziki sauce. The wrap is placed on a wooden board, garnished with fresh herbs and accompanied by a small bowl of tzatziki sauce on the side. The filling ingredients are visible, showcasing a generous portion of the gyro.

name: Pollo a la Brasa (Peruvian Roast Chicken)
directions: Marinate chicken with garlic, cumin, paprika, salt, and pepper.
Roast at 200°C (400°F) for 40-45 minutes until cooked.
Serve with lime wedges.
image_description: The image depicts a roasted chicken, cut into eight pieces and arranged on a brown ceramic platter. The chicken is golden brown with visible seasonings and herbs, surrounded by sliced limes and spices, and is presented as a whole roasted chicken broken down into portions, likely serving 4-6 people.

name: Mango Salsa Chicken
directions: Season chicken and sear in a pan.
Top with mango salsa (mango, onion, cilantro, lime juice).
Bake 10 minutes to finish cooking.
image_description: The image shows a plate of grilled chicken breasts topped with a vibrant mango salsa. Four chicken breasts are arranged on a white plate with a brown rim, each featuring grill marks and topped with a mixture of diced mango, red onion, red pepper, and cilantro. The dish is garnished with three lime wedges and surrounded by additional cilantro leaves on the plate and the dark gray surface beneath it.

name: Rice Paper Rolls with Peanut Dip
directions: Soak rice papers; fill with noodles, greens, and protein.
Roll tightly; serve with peanut dip.
image_description: The image shows a platter of rice paper rolls with peanut dip, featuring four rolls filled with shrimp, carrots, and vegetables, accompanied by a bowl of creamy peanut sauce garnished with sesame seeds and mint leaves. The platter is surrounded by various ingredients, including sliced cucumbers, shredded carrots, lettuce leaves, rice noodles, tofu, and chopped nuts. The dish is presented in a visually appealing arrangement on a round, woven tray.

name: Beef Nachos
directions: Cook beef with seasoning.
Layer chips, beef, and cheese; bake until cheese melts.
Top with beans, salsa, sour cream, and jalapenos.
image_description: The image showcases a vibrant platter of beef nachos, featuring tortilla chips smothered in melted cheese, seasoned ground beef, and beans. The dish is garnished with sliced jalapeños, cherry tomatoes, and a dollop of sour cream, adding a pop of color and freshness to the presentation. The platter is surrounded by various toppings and condiments, including salsa, shredded cheese, and diced herbs, creating a visually appealing and appetizing spread.

name: Herbed Chicken Skewers

In the same wok, sauté garlic, ginger, and dried chilies until fragrant.

Remove lid and cook until water evaporates and bottoms are crispy again.

Stir in the rice vinegar at the very end to preserve the 'sour' punch.
Garnish with green onions.

name: Chow Mein
directions: Boil noodles according to package instructions, drain, and set aside.
Heat oil in a wok and stir-fry cabbage and carrots for 3 minutes.
Add the noodles to the wok.
Mix soy sauce, oyster sauce, and sugar, then pour over the noodles.
Toss at high heat for 2-3 minutes until noodles are slightly charred and well coated.
Serve hot.

name: Wonton Soup
directions: Bring chicken broth and soy sauce to a boil in a pot.
Add the wontons and simmer for 5 minutes (or until they float).
Add bok choy and cook for 1 minute until wilted.
Turn off heat and stir in sesame oil.
Ladle into bowls and garnish with green onions.

name: Honey Walnut Shrimp
directions: Dip shrimp in egg, then coat with cornstarch.
Fry shrimp in hot oil until golden and crispy; drain.
In a large bowl, whisk together mayonnaise, honey, and condensed milk.
Toss the warm shrimp and candied walnuts into the sauce until evenly coated.
Serve immediately, usually garnished with steamed broccoli.
